extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer. Ships no default keyboard shortcuts; users assign their own. All data is plain Markdown and YAML frontmatter, so notes stay readable with the plugin removed.
problem: Obsidian provides no built-in structure for typed notes, topic Maps, and an ACE (Atlas/Calendar/Efforts) folder framework.

relations.evidence: ACE Actions is inspired by Linking Your Thinking and its ACE folder framework and borrows heavily from them.

summary: Plugin for the ACE note structure that creates typed notes, links them to Maps, files them by kind, and starts Efforts.
